messages:
sam-identity: Notifying here 1: after the role-name normalization change yesterday some SAML assertions with long role lists are getting truncated by our attribute parser. Result: users in 2 tenants got mapped to the default 'platform-viewer' role instead of their intended 'billing-admin' / 'org-admin' mappings.

ria-eng: Are these the same tenants that hit the name-length linter warnings during rollout?

sam-identity: No, those passed. This looks like runtime truncation inside the SAML attribute aggregator, not the rollout linter. Quick log: 
```
2026-03-24T16:12:31Z sam-attr-agg WARN attr_parse: roles attribute length=10240 truncated_to=4096
2026-03-24T16:12:31Z scim-sync INFO map_roles: mapped 1 -> platform-viewer (fallback)
```

omar-sre: Could truncation flip a comma-separated list so the last value becomes a different role id? We should check delimiter handling and unicode bytes vs characters.

lina-sec: Security note: this could be abused if an identity provider intentionally passes a long role value ending with a high-privilege role that is exposed after truncation. We should treat as potential privilege escalator until proven otherwise.

kevin-support: Customers reporting users lost access to billing console and can't approve invoices. High business impact for two mid-market customers. PS tickets created and marked high priority.

sam-identity: Immediate mitigation: short-term patch to reject any roles attribute > 4096 bytes with a 400 and log tenant id. That will surface malicious inputs instead of silently truncating. Thoughts?

omar-sre: Agreed. We can push a hotfix to attr-agg: if attribute length > 4096 return 400 and send an alert. Also we can add a config toggle to treat long attrs as denylist per-tenant.

lina-sec: While we patch, start vuln triage: 1) check auth audit logs for any successful elevation in last 30d where mapped_role != asserted_role. 2) add an IDS rule to flag submissions with trailing comma sequences or non-printable chars in roles.

sam-identity: Running audit query now: 
```sql
SELECT timestamp, tenant_id, asserted_roles, mapped_role FROM auth_audit
WHERE mapped_role != asserted_roles LIMIT 100;
```

omar-sre: Also check KMS envelope handling for external id (extid) encoding in case some tenants have different envelope size thresholds. Not necessarily related but worth ruling out.

lina-sec: Good call. If KMS wrapping changes the payload size it might interact with attribute length limits in proxies. But priority is preventing privilege flips.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03124 RoleAttributeTruncation. Pager duty notified.

kevin-support: Customer comms: I'll tell affected customers we're rolling a fix that will either restore mappings or surface invalid assertions; ETA 45m.

omar-sre: Hotfix plan: 
- branch: fix/saml-attr-reject-long
- change: add max_bytes check + 400 response + metric saml.attr.large{tenant}
- canary -> full deploy (30m)

sam-identity: I'll prepare the patch and unit tests for delimiter boundaries and UTF-8 byte handling.

lina-sec: Triage steps for vuln assessment: 
- reproduce: craft SAML with long roles ending with 'org-admin' and see mapped role after truncation
- scope: grep audit logs for any matching tenant patterns in last 90 days
- exploitability: check if any IdP could send such assertions (okta/ADFS/OneLogin) without additional signing constraints

omar-sre: I pushed canary. Metric shows attr.large spikes for two tenants. Canary passed basic tests. Kicking full roll now.

incident-bot: deploy fix/saml-attr-reject-long deployed by omar-sre:sha=cd34ab (rolling)

kevin-support: Customers updated. They want an RCA and confirmation that no unauthorized privileges were granted.

sam-identity: Audit result preliminary: no mapped_role != asserted_role matches older than these incidents. Looks like we did not have any silent flips in historical data for these tenants. Will continue full scan.

lina-sec: If audit remains clean, remediation items: 
- permanent fix: reject + log long attrs + add policy to map based on role IDs not raw strings
- defensive: add unit tests for attribute parsing across encodings and add integration test with Okta/ADFS SAML samples
- ops: alert for saml.attr.large and for sudden drops in 'role assignment success' metric

omar-sre: Also adding a config to limit per-tenant role count (e.g., max 200 roles asserted) to prevent OOM/CPU attacks.

kevin-support: I'll follow up with CS for compensation offers if needed for impacted customers.

sam-identity: Postmortem owner: sam-identity. Lina will own vuln-triage section. Omar will own deploy/ops remediation. Kevin will handle customer comms. Expected postmortem draft within 48h.

lina-sec: One more: add runbook note: when you see sudden role fallbacks, check `saml-attr-agg` logs for "truncated_to" and query for any unusual byte-length attributes.

omar-sre: Closing loop on deploy: metrics returning to baseline and scim-sync no longer mapping to platform-viewer for affected tenants.

kevin-support: Customers acknowledged and are waiting for RCA. Thanks team.
